name: openhouse
description: Rent-to-own, on-chain — the protocol takes 1–5% (owner-set, capped in the contract) and 95–99% of every payment stays with the property as renter equity and owner income

mcp.docs: Model Context Protocol (JSON-RPC 2.0 over Streamable HTTP) tool server for LLM agents — POST /mcp on the API. Reads: openhouse_terms, openhouse_quote, openhouse_models, openhouse_status, openhouse_property, openhouse_rent_stats, openhouse_rent_ledger, openhouse_equity, openhouse_shareholders, openhouse_portfolio, openhouse_dividends, openhouse_landscape, openhouse_source. Writes (testnet bookkeeping, no signed transactions): openhouse_pay_rent, openhouse_purchase, openhouse_set_terms, openhouse_claim_owner.
